documents.unit: UNMC Policies (Policy No. 8020)
documents.title: UNMC AI Use Guidelines
documents.summary: UNMC's campus AI guidelines, enforced through the codes of conduct. In education, students must follow each instructor's AI expectations and may be required to disclose and cite use; misuse is handled as academic misconduct; faculty may prohibit, allow with attribution, or encourage AI and should state per-assignment rules; faculty may use AI for course materials. It also restricts AI to low-risk data and holds users accountable for outputs. Tier 4 (university-general fallback).

documents.title: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai Policy: Using Artificial Intelligence in Teaching, Learning, and Discovery
documents.summary: ISMMS's school-wide AI policy for students, faculty and staff. AI use in learning is at the instructional-unit director's discretion, AI content must be disclosed and cited, AI is prohibited in graded assessments unless explicitly permitted, every syllabus must state the permitted AI level (full, limited, no use), and faculty must not put student work into public AI detectors. It also sets strict data, PHI and IP rules and annual review. Tier 4 (university-general fallback).

documents.university: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences
documents.unit: Division of Academic Affairs (Council of Deans, Provost)
documents.title: UAMS Academic Affairs Policy 2.1.6: UAMS Artificial Intelligence Generative Tool Use Policy
documents.summary: UAMS's formal academic-affairs policy on generative AI. It treats unattributed AI-generated work as plagiarism, requires disclosure of AI use (with exemptions for approved tools and mechanical uses), requires instructor authorization for student use with three course levels (prohibited, restricted, unrestricted), bars instructors from putting student work into AI or AI detectors without approval, calls detectors unreliable, requires governance-committee approval for AI-assisted grading, and mandates annual AI training. Tier 4 (university-general fallback).
